title: 8.20 Introduction to Special Relativity
description: Four-week IAP course (19 live sessions, flipped classroom) on special relativity with a glance at general relativity: foundations and the Michelson-Morley experiment; time dilation, length contraction, spacetime diagrams, causality and the standard 'paradoxes'; Lorentz transformations, 4-vectors, momentum and energy, collisions; tests and applications, electromagnetism, equivalence principle, GPS. Published as 52 short lecture videos in four weekly groups, plus problem sets, exams and readings.
rightsNotes: Content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by MIT OpenCourseWare (licence link in the page footer). Corniversity is private and non-commercial.

The course has no lecture notes; the videos are the primary material and are hosted on YouTube and the Internet Archive via OCW pages. Textbooks (French 1968, Resnick 1968) are commercial and not required by Corniversity.
The Readings page lists weekly 'papers of the week' linking to external sites with their own terms.

Week 1: Foundations of Special Relativity (Lectures 1.1–3.4: course organisation, history, space/time/spacetime, categories of physics, events, Galilean transformation, light, waves, Michelson-Morley, stellar aberration)

Week 2: Spacetime in Special Relativity (Lectures 4.1–7.4: time dilation, muons, length contraction, invariance, Lorentz transformation, velocity addition, spacetime diagrams, regions, causality, pole-in-the-barn, twin paradox, spacecraft-on-a-rope, Doppler effect, redshift, galaxy travel)

Week 3: Kinematics in Special Relativity (Lectures 8.1–9.4: algebra of Lorentz transformations, 4-vector notation, proper velocity, momentum and energy conservation, collisions, forces and kinetic energy)

Week 4: Beyond Special Relativity (Lectures 10.1–13.1: tests, LEP, deuteron production, photons, pion decay, particle creation, Compton effect, GPS, charge and current, electric and magnetic fields, equivalence principle, gravitational time dilation, light bending, redshift tests, general relativity, experimental evidence, review)
